name: Multiple Scattering Volume Path Tracing with Phase Function Sampling
definition: A path tracing algorithm for multiple homogeneous volumes that handles multiple scattering events by sampling the phase function, supporting index-matched surfaces and Russian roulette termination.
summary: This path tracing algorithm handles multiple scattering in homogeneous volumes by explicitly sampling the phase function for direction selection, distinguishing itself from methods that rely solely on delta tracking or explicit light source sampling.
